name: Olimpo.DigitalSignature (.NET)
notes: Signature contract used with both P-01 and P-02. .NET BouncyCastle ECDSA uses a random nonce by default: signature bytes are not required to match across runtimes; cross-verification of generated signatures is the contract for non-deterministic producers.
signatureBehavior: SHA-256withECDSA over UTF-8 message bytes; DER-encoded signature default; compact 64-byte r||s and base64 variants; verification accepts DER or compact; public address helpers include compressed encoding
